source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-DWR3SS1 Top Control Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect the power supply to the dishwasher.

steps.title: Ed behavior
steps.body: Ed logs when the display board cannot receive or the main board cannot send for more than 20 seconds.
steps.sourceExcerpt: when the display board cant receive or the main board can't send signal over 20 seconds

steps.title: CN2 display harness seated
steps.body: Remove control panel. Is CN2 (display board) fully seated with no bent pins?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove control panel. Is CN2 (display board) fully seated with no bent pins?

steps.title: CN2 harness continuity
steps.body: With power off, verify continuity on harness between main PCB CN2 and display PCB (no opens).
steps.sourceExcerpt: With power off, verify continuity on harness between main PCB CN2 and display PCB (no opens).

steps.title: Reseat and retest
steps.body: Reseat CN2 and cycle progress indicator harness; restore power and verify display responds.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reseat CN2 and cycle progress indicator harness; restore power and verify display responds.

steps.title: Replace display or PCB
steps.body: Replace display assembly or main PCB per failed path.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace display assembly or main PCB per failed path.

steps.title: Communication verified
steps.body: CN2 path OK — Ed should not return.
steps.oemOutcome: CN2 path OK — Ed should not return.
